land:
{directive}You lead {agent}. {balance}

{doctrine}Decision point {point}, {title}. {situation} {question} {others}The crew has already done its drill (cover, and return fire if it can see the shooter). Compare reach both ways and numbers before choosing.
balance: The intent comes first; keep the unit alive and able to carry it out; take a local opportunity only when it doesn't cost the intent. A unit that keeps its strength can still take the objective; one spent in a losing exchange cannot.
others: Also deciding now, so choose to work together: {names}.
statePointer: What it knows is under units.{agent} in the state: itself, its weapons and how far they reach, the enemy it has seen (and how far they reach), its orders, its ground and its friends.
statePointerProse: {situation} What it knows is under units.{agent} in the state.
landNote: Only what each unit believes. Enemies it has not found are not listed, and their absence is not evidence that they are not there. A lost contact is where an enemy was last seen, not where it is.
worldNote: Each question is raised from what that agent knows, not the truth. Choose within its doctrine.

optionWords.land.askFriendForHelp: Ask a friend in reach to fire on the shooter, adding guns without moving. Best when the friend has weapons that can hurt this enemy and it does not. Useless if no friend is near.
optionWords.land.assault: Assault the shooter: close and fight through. Only against a clearly weaker enemy at close range; otherwise ruinous.
optionWords.land.betterPosition: Move to another firing position (hull-down, closer, a flank) before engaging; no fire while moving. Best when it cannot hurt the enemy from here, or when it sits exposed to an enemy that out-ranges it. On an advance it costs time, and it is no reason to stop for a contact that is not firing.
optionWords.land.carryOn: Carry on with what it was doing (advancing, holding, hiding); the crew keeps its drill and still fires in self-defence. Usually right for a contact that is far, unidentified, static or not firing, while its orders still have ground to cover or it is unseen. Wrong when an enemy that can hurt it is firing on it unanswered.
optionWords.land.coverFromBearing: Move into cover that masks it from that bearing. This protects it while the shooter is found.
optionWords.land.engageNow: Stop and open fire from here. Right only when a weapon that can actually hurt this target reaches it, the ROE allows fire at that range, and firing serves its orders. Firing gives away a hidden unit, and stopping stalls an advance. It is usually wrong against a distant, unidentified or static contact while its orders say move on.
optionWords.land.fireNow: Fire now from hiding. Right when the enemy is inside the reach of weapons that can hurt it. Light weapons do not hurt armoured vehicles. Out of reach, or with the wrong weapons, it wastes rounds, gives the position away and hits nothing.
optionWords.land.goQuietInCover: Stop firing and hide in nearby cover. Useless on open ground with no cover, and it leaves the shooter unanswered.
optionWords.land.helpFriend: Fire on the attacker of the friend in trouble, from here.
optionWords.land.holdHere: Stop and hold the ground here, ready to fire. Right when its orders are to hold or its last step is done. If steps remain or its next point is still ahead, holding stalls the plan.
optionWords.land.hullDownThenFire: Move hull-down, then return fire. It delays the answer but shrinks what the enemy can hit. Worth the delay when weakened, suppressed or outnumbered.
optionWords.land.keepAtIt: Keep firing on the same target. Wasteful, and it reveals the unit, if its weapons cannot hurt that target.
optionWords.land.keepHoldingHere: Stay where it is, ready to fire. Right only when holding is the task, or its final step is done. If its orders still have steps or a point ahead, staying stalls the plan.
optionWords.land.letPass: Let the enemy pass unengaged and stay hidden. Sound when the enemy is beyond the reach of weapons that can hurt it, or is not its target. When an enemy it is meant to ambush is in reach, this fails the task.
optionWords.land.moveToSupport: Move toward the friend in trouble to support it.
optionWords.land.observe: Stay still, hold fire and watch, keeping the contact in view and reporting it to friends. Good for a hidden unit facing an enemy it cannot hurt, or one that has not seen it. Poor on open ground within the enemy's reach, and it stalls an advance.
optionWords.land.outOfSight: Pull back out of the enemy's sight. If its weapons out-range the enemy, it can fire from beyond the enemy's reach. Right when outnumbered or weakened in the open.
optionWords.land.outOfTargetSight: Pull back out of the target's sight, where it can no longer be hit by it.
optionWords.land.overwatchHere: Stay here and overwatch, firing at anything in reach. Right when friends are moving under its cover or the final step is to hold. When its own orders still have steps or a point ahead, it stalls the plan.
optionWords.land.pullBackFromBearing: Pull back away from that bearing. It gives up ground and leaves the shooter unfound.
optionWords.land.pullBackToFriends: Turn away and pull back toward friends, out of the enemy's reach. It gives up ground and fire, and moving can reveal a hidden unit. Only right when it is outmatched and already seen, or exposed in the open.
optionWords.land.resumeOrders: Resume its orders: move on with the current step toward its next point. Right when steps remain (phase below its total) or a destination is still ahead, and nothing blocks it. Only if the final step is done is there nothing to resume.
optionWords.land.returnFire: Return fire on the shooter now, from here. Right on even or better terms with weapons that can hurt it. Weakened and outnumbered on open ground, it loses the exchange.
optionWords.land.searchBearing: Search the bearing the fire came from to find the shooter, ready to fire on it.
optionWords.land.shiftFireFromTarget: Shift fire to another target its weapons can actually hurt.
optionWords.land.skipToNextPhase: Drop the current step and start the next one. Only when the current step cannot be finished; it leaves that step undone.
optionWords.land.stopFiring: Stop firing and go quiet, so that fire which cannot hurt the target no longer gives its position away.
optionWords.land.waitCloser: Stay hidden and hold fire until the enemy comes inside the reach of weapons that can hurt it, then fire. Right while the enemy is beyond that reach but may close; costs nothing while it stays unseen.
optionWords.land.waitFor: Hold fire and wait for a better moment (closer, inside the reach of weapons that can hurt it, or a flank), then fire. Sound when hidden or beyond the enemy's reach. Costly when exposed, or when its orders need it to keep moving.
